user.title: Energy Tariff Helper
user.description: Name this meter. You'll set its tariff windows next.

supply_charge.title: Daily supply charge
supply_charge.description: A fixed amount billed per day, regardless of usage.

add_import_window.title: Add an import window
add_import_window.description: A recurring daily period when you pay this import rate. Start is inclusive, end is exclusive. If the end is earlier than the start, the window spans midnight.

edit_import_window.title: Edit an import window
edit_import_window.description: Pick the import window to change.

edit_import_window_details.title: Edit import window
edit_import_window_details.description: A recurring daily period when you pay this import rate. Start is inclusive, end is exclusive. If the end is earlier than the start, the window spans midnight.

remove_import_window.title: Remove an import window
remove_import_window.description: Pick the import window to remove.

add_export_window.title: Add an export window
add_export_window.description: A recurring daily period when you are paid this export rate. Start is inclusive, end is exclusive. If the end is earlier than the start, the window spans midnight.

edit_export_window.title: Edit an export window
edit_export_window.description: Pick the export window to change.

edit_export_window_details.title: Edit export window
edit_export_window_details.description: A recurring daily period when you are paid this export rate. Start is inclusive, end is exclusive. If the end is earlier than the start, the window spans midnight.

remove_export_window.title: Remove an export window
remove_export_window.description: Pick the export window to remove.

error.zero_length_window: The start and end times must be different.

abort.no_windows: There are no windows configured for that direction.
